lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct horizontal and vertical rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible, with circular blobs acting as nodes at the intersections of these vertical bands and horizontal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One prominent horizontal linear feature is visible extending from the upper gill region posteriorly, defined by a highlight along the ridge crest and a shadow gradient immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of approximately six commensal fish (remoras) trailing and attached to the ventral-lateral region near the pectoral fin.
